Name: Prismatic Neon Tools
Author: seolri
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Neon recolor of the tools. Made for personal use but I figured I'd release it for all the neon lovers out there. I was originally going for a "gem" vibe but this is fine too. It started out as picking colors for practice and then it turned into me googling how to make my own tool recolor mod lol

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
1. Download the mod
2. Unzip it in to your mods folder

[b]Having problems?[/b]
If you're having issues, just drop a comment and I'll see what I can do.

[b]FAQ[/b]
Q. Will you ever make a toggle so the entire toolset is one color? Or making it so that I can pick specific colors for each tier of tools?
A. Maybe. I'm not too savvy with coding so it will have to wait until I'm in the mood to sit down and figure all that out.

Q. I like certain colors over others. Can I make personal edits?
A. Me too man, me too. If you'd like to make an edit for personal use go ahead, [b]however if you intend to publish it,[/b] [b]you must credit me[/b].

Q. These are really bright and burn my eyes! Can you tone them down?
A. I won't be making darker versions, this mod was made on a whim.

Manifest.Name: Prismatic Neon Tools
Manifest.Description: Recolors the tools into neon gemlike versions.
Manifest.Author: seolri
